title: Product Lead
description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

PRODUCT LEAD

€120K - €160K • Offers Equity

Freecash is the product. Almedia is the engagement engine behind it: the smartest way for mobile game studios to turn high-potential users into high-value ones. We're the leader in our category, profitable, and expanding fast.

We're hiring one exceptional Product Leader. Not a fixed lane: real scope, real ownership, and a path to leading a team. If you think like a founder and can't sleep until the data tells you why, keep reading.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- End-to-end outcomes, not tickets. Hypothesis, roadmap, build, metrics, result: you own all of it. You find the highest-impact bets before anyone asks, and you execute. Discovery and delivery are the same job.

- The hard, ambiguous problems. Form a sharp point of view, validate against the data, ship with conviction, kill it honestly when the numbers disagree.

- Scope that grows. We point you at the biggest opportunity. As you earn it, that expands across Freecash and into new verticals.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- You think like a founder. You make the call with incomplete information, hold a strong opinion about what will work and why, then prove or disprove it. You don't wait to be told what matters.

- You live in the data. You dig in yourself, follow the thread, and come back with the insight nobody else found. Data tells you what to solve. Creativity decides how. Comfortable in Amplitude, Hex, and Looker.

- You prioritize ruthlessly. Anyone can list a hundred things. You pick the few that matter right now.

- You execute. Ideation to launch to iteration. You bring developers, data, design, and BD with you without slowing down.

- You know consumer products. Built and shipped consumer-facing apps.

WHAT PUTS YOU AHEAD

- You've been a founder. You know what it means to own an outcome with no one to hand it off to.

- You've scaled through hyper-growth. 50 to 200+ people, building the plane mid-flight: familiar territory.

- Mobile gaming or advertising background. You know the players, the incentives, the dynamics.

WHY ALMEDIA?

- Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

- Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

- Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

- Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Growth Engineer
description:
ClickHouse is looking for Growth Engineers who are obsessed with both craft UI and agentic experiences. You care about the button, the empty state, and the agent that helps someone get unstuck, and you care equally about whether any of it moved the number.

You’ll join our growth pod to build experimentation infrastructure, onboarding flows, and product surfaces across the self-serve funnel: classic human UI and AI-assisted / agent-driven flows. You’ll work side by side with unified console engineers, but your mandate is speed and impact: ship something testable, measure it, and iterate. You’re motivated by moving a number and learning fast, more than by getting every detail right on the first try.

This is a new role at ClickHouse. You’ll help define what growth engineering looks like here: PLG experimentation that spans human and agentic experiences. You’ll work closely with product, design, and data science on one pod, and partner with unified console and app teams on shared product surfaces.

What you will do:

- Build and ship experiments across the self-serve funnel: signup, onboarding, activation, and monetization flows.

- Design and polish human UI (flows, forms, empty states, navigation, microcopy surfaces) with a high bar for clarity and conversion.

- Design and ship agentic experiences (AI-assisted onboarding, in-product agents, guided workflows) that help users reach value faster.

- Run disciplined experiments on both: hypothesis, instrumentation, ship, learn. Tools like GrowthBook are part of the day-to-day.

- Partner closely with product, design, and data science to go from idea to shipped experiment quickly.

- Work within the Cloud Console codebase alongside unified console engineers, and partner with app teams (including Observability, Agents, and Postgres) on strong end-to-end user flows.

- Obsess over metrics: acquisition, activation, and monetization. You want proof that what you shipped moved the needle.

Requirements:

- Experienced in full-stack product engineering (TypeScript / Node / React), ideally including time on a growth, product, or experimentation-focused team.

- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with real taste for product UI.

- Experience building with LLMs or agent patterns in a product (tool calling, streaming, evals, system/prompt design), or a clear track record of shipping AI features you measured and iterated on.

- Comfortable shipping a smaller, testable version of an idea first, then iterating based on what you learn.

- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON.

- Experience with experimentation or A/B testing tools (e.g. GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly), or strong interest in building that muscle.

- Proficient with Git and collaborative code review.

- Excellent communication skills. You’ll work daily with PM, design, data science, marketing, and other engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

- You’ve shipped both polished UI experiments and agentic / AI-assisted product experiences (not just prototypes), with instrumentation and iteration.

- Experience on a growth or product-led-growth team, ideally at a company with a self-serve funnel.

- Experience with ClickHouse or other data-intensive/analytics products.

- Familiarity with Auth0 or similar auth integrations.

- Experience working closely with (but not necessarily reporting into) a separate platform or infrastructure engineering team.

- You have opinions on what makes great human UX and great agent UX, and you use AI heavily in your own workflow.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

title: AI Researcher — Training Optimization
description:
About the Role
We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on training optimization to help us push the efficiency, stability, and scalability of large-scale model training. You’ll work at the intersection of research and systems , developing novel techniques to reduce training cost, accelerate convergence, and improve model quality-while validating ideas through rigorous experiments and publications.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning research insights into practical training wins , and who has a track record (or strong ambition) of publishing applied ML research .
What You’ll Work On

• Design and evaluate training optimization techniques for large models (e.g. optimization algorithms, schedulers, normalization, curriculum strategies)

• Improve training efficiency and stability across long runs and large datasets

•
Research and implement methods such as:

• Optimizer and scheduler innovations

• Mixed-precision, low-precision, and memory-efficient training

• Gradient noise reduction, scaling laws, and convergence analysis

• Training-time regularization and robustness techniques

• Run large-scale experiments, analyze results, and translate findings into actionable improvements

• Author or co-author research papers, technical reports, or blog posts

• Collaborate closely with infrastructure and inference teams to ensure training decisions translate to real-world performance

What We’re Looking For

• Strong background in machine learning research , with emphasis on training dynamics and optimization

• Experience training large neural networks (LLMs, multimodal models, or large sequence models)

• Publication experience in ML venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM, arXiv) or equivalent high-quality open research

•
Solid understanding of:

• Optimization theory and practice

• Backpropagation, gradient flow, and training stability

• Distributed and large-batch training

• Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch preferred)

• Ability to independently design experiments and reason from data

Nice to Have

• Experience with non-standard architectures (e.g. RNN variants, long-context models, hybrid systems)

• Experience optimizing training on GPUs at scale (FSDP, ZeRO, custom kernels)

• Contributions to open-source ML or research codebases

• Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments

Why This Role

• Real influence over core model training decisions

• Freedom to pursue and publish novel research

• Direct access to large-scale experiments and real production constraints

• A small, senior team that values thinking deeply and shipping thoughtfully
